sample_unit: adults living with HIV with depression symptoms (SEEK-GSP trial participants)

links.outcome: Calibration (slope, Brier score, AUC) before and after recalibration on external validation set
links.effect: Isotonic regression recalibration improved calibration slope from 1.703 to 1.00, Brier score from 0.070 to 0.015, and AUC to 0.986.
links.quote: Post-calibration isotonic regression improved probability alignment (slope 1.703 to 1.00; Brier 0.070 to 0.015; AUC 0.986).

links.outcome: Discrimination performance on geographically distinct external validation set
links.effect: All three models kept excellent discrimination in Pader district external validation (AUC 0.974–0.980); no performance drop at new site.
links.quote: All models demonstrated excellent discrimination in geographically distinct external validation (AUC 0.974–0.980).

unlisted_practices: Treatment-adjusted risk prediction to allocate group-based psychotherapy (precision allocation of care)

screen.reason: Pure model-development and retrospective external validation study predicting depression non-remission without testing deployment, workflow, or organizational safeguards.
